Their unique aroma is not for everyone.|Recipe Book|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Monster Rice Balls are a [[Meal]] that can be made by [[Cooking]] [[Hylian Rice]], [[Rock Salt]], and [[Monster Extract]] together in a [[Cooking Pot]]. Due to Monster Extract being used in their making, the amount of [[Heart]]s restored to [[Link]], as well as the strength and duration of any status effects, will be random. The unique aroma of Monster Rice Balls is disliked by many people. By incorporating additional [[Ingredient]]s to the recipe, several different variations of Monster Rice Balls can be made: * '''Chilly Monster Rice Balls''':{{Cite|{{Big|Chilly Monster Rice Balls}}
Grants low-level heat resistance.
Rice balls flavored with monster extract. Their unique aroma is not for everyone.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding chilly Ingredients. They can be eaten to grant Link one level of [[Heat Resistance]]. * '''Electro Monster Rice Balls''':{{Cite|{{Big|Electro Monster Rice Balls}}
Grants low-level electricity resistance.
Rice balls flavored with monster extract. Their unique aroma is not for everyone.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding electric Ingredients. If eaten, Link will be granted one level of [[Shock Resistance]]. * '''Enduring Monster Rice Balls''':{{Cite|{{Big|Enduring Monster Rice Balls}}
Restores and overfills your Stamina Wheel.
Rice balls flavored with monster extract. Their unique aroma is not for everyone.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding enduring Ingredients. When eaten, they will completely restore and overfill Link's [[Stamina Wheel]]. * '''Energizing Monster Rice Balls''':{{Cite|{{Big|Energizing Monster Rice Balls}}
Instantly refills some of your Stamina Wheel.
Rice balls flavored with monster extract. Their unique aroma is not for everyone.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding energizing Ingredients. They will refill a portion of Link's Stamina Wheel when eaten. * '''Hasty Monster Rice Balls''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hasty Monster Rice Balls}}
Grants a low-level movement-speed boost.
Rice balls flavored with monster extract. Their unique aroma is not for everyone.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding hasty Ingredients. Link can eat them to gain boost to his movement speed. * '''Hearty Monster Rice Balls''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hearty Monster Rice Balls}}
Restores your health and temporarily increases your maximum hearts.
Rice balls flavored with monster extract. Their unique aroma is not for everyone.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding hearty Ingredients. These rice balls will heal all of Link's Hearts and grant him [[Extra Hearts]]. * '''Mighty Monster Rice Balls''':{{Cite|{{Big|Mighty Monster Rice Balls}}
Grants a low-level attack-power boost.
Rice balls flavored with monster extract. Their unique aroma is not for everyone.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding mighty Ingredients. When these rice balls are eaten, Link will receive a boost to his attack power. * '''Sneaky Monster Rice Balls''':{{Cite|{{Big|Sneaky Monster Rice Balls}}
Grants a low-level stealth boost.
Rice balls flavored with monster extract. Their unique aroma is not for everyone.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding sneaky Ingredients. Eating one will increase Link's [[Stealth]]. * '''Spicy Monster Rice Balls''':{{Cite|{{Big|Spicy Monster Rice Balls}}
Grants low-level cold resistance.
Rice balls flavored with monster extract. Their unique aroma is not for everyone.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding spicy Ingredients. Eating them will increase Link's [[Cold Resistance]] by one level. * '''Tough Monster Rice Balls''':{{Cite|{{Big|Tough Monster Rice Balls}}
Grants a low-level defense boost.
Rice balls flavored with monster extract. Their unique aroma is not for everyone.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding tough Ingredients. Link will gain a boost to his [[Defense]] when he eats these. ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Food * Meal }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Food, Health Restoring Items, Meals, Rice Balls |items= BotW, TotK }}
